purpose: Rule ledger for continuity, monotonicity, cyclic monotonicity, and graphical checks in Section 24.

rules.name: Pairwise monotonicity
rules.test: For p in partial f(x) and q in partial f(y), dot(x-y,p-q) >= 0.
rules.visual_check: Any two points on the subgradient graph rise together in the coordinatewise order.

rules.name: Closed graph
rules.test: If x_i -> x, p_i -> p, and p_i in partial f(x_i), then p in partial f(x).
rules.visual_check: Limit points of plotted graph samples stay on the graph, including vertical jump intervals.

rules.name: Local boundedness on compact cores
rules.test: On closed bounded S inside int dom f, partial f(S) is closed and bounded.
rules.visual_check: A compact x-window has a finite slope ceiling and yields a Lipschitz bound.

rules.name: Smooth-region continuity
rules.test: Closed graph plus local boundedness plus singleton partial f(x) forces gradient convergence.
rules.visual_check: Gradient arrows vary continuously where the subgradient set has only one vector.

rules.name: Cyclic monotonicity
rules.test: For every finite cycle, sum_i dot(x_i-x_{i+1},p_i) >= 0 under the deck convention.
rules.visual_check: The cycle has no negative work loop when read as a potential gradient field.

rules.name: Linear matrix check
rules.test: P(x)=Qx is monotone iff the symmetric part (Q+Q^T)/2 is positive semidefinite; it is cyclically monotone iff Q is symmetric positive semidefinite.
rules.visual_check: A skew part may spin arrows without failing pairwise monotonicity, but it fails the cycle test.
